reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20 agent-R: original question cited Rule VIII Sec. 808 for projecting-element clearance from side and rear property lines. The 750 mm requirement for eaves over required windows is in Rule VII Sec. 704(1)(c) per the source pack, not Rule VIII Sec. 808. Citation and text corrected to align with the source; the answer (750 mm) is unchanged.

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 704(1)(c), eaves over required window openings must be at least how far from the side and rear property lines?
proposed.rationale: Section 704(1)(c) requires eaves over required windows to be not less than 750 mm from the side and rear property lines. This rule is narrow: it applies specifically to eaves over required windows on side and rear lines, not to all projections or all facades.
proposed.explanation: The original citation to Rule VIII Sec. 808 was incorrect; the 750 mm eave-clearance rule is in Rule VII Sec. 704(1)(c) per the source pack. Front-yard setbacks remain governed by local zoning and Rule VII Sec. 702-703.
